A rectangular boundary/air relaxation estimate is not an optimum for arbitrary phase mobility, complex masks or dense beds.
Two-second high-sweep false currents persist with small equation residuals; full transfer, constraint and boundary consistency need qualification.
The 64 operator criteria comprise32 manufactured setups measured at120/480 sweeps, not a universal convergence proof.
Diagnostic residuals use projection-scaled pressure units, not physical pascals. Measurement refuses a mismatched restored-pressure/reprojection RHS.
No fresh native render/FPS qualification in this stage. Short diagnostic/replay timings do not prove a throughput gain.
The game library retains98 pre-existing Clippy warnings; changed engine spans are clean. Full legacy engine formatting and its57 other library tests were not claimed.
